integrity: The proof uses the published symmetric half-degree principle as a stated cited input, gives exact two-level computations and a complete convex averaging proof of the ellipsoid optimum. The standalone checker verifies algebra; finite sampling is not treated as proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the real codimension-one zero-sum subspaces of ell-four in finite dimensions n at least three; no claim for complex scalars, weighted coordinates, other exponents, or uniqueness of optimal maps. Earliest verified supporting public source is arXiv:1001.4464v1 submitted 2010-01-25 UTC. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not established.
title: Exact Euclidean distortion of zero-sum real \(\ell_4\) hyperplanes
